description: Controlled mutations are evaluation inputs. Some cases intentionally probe capabilities not implemented in the current baseline; those must be reported as such, not silently passed.

cases.name: Harmless whitespace variation
cases.target: Support agents should classify each issue, record the affected service, and give users a clear next step.
cases.replacement: Support agents should classify   each issue, record the affected service, and give users a clear next step.
must_preserve: give users a clear next step
cases.purpose: Check whether harmless extra spaces cause unexplained content loss.

cases.name: Repeated notice insertion
cases.append_text:
## Mutation repeated notice
Scheduled maintenance notice: the test portal may be unavailable during the published maintenance window. Save work before maintenance and check the service status page for updates.
must_preserve: Scheduled maintenance notice: the test portal may be unavailable
cases.purpose: Observe duplication behavior when an exact notice appears more than once.

cases.name: Removed source sentence
cases.target: Support agents should classify each issue, record the affected service, and give users a clear next step.
must_preserve: Please compare content, not only chunk counts.
Record the time, error message, and relevant request or incident identifier.
expected_removed: Support agents should classify each issue, record the affected service, and give users a clear next step.
cases.purpose: Ensure intentional source deletion is distinguishable from a chunker accidentally losing content; the report records the expected removal.

cases.name: Unresolved cross-reference
cases.append_text:
## Mutation reference
For a special case, see Section 99.9, which is intentionally absent from this document.
must_preserve: which is intentionally absent from this document
cases.purpose: Check whether an explicit link to a missing target can be detected and flagged.

cases.name: Caption separated from table
cases.target: Table 1: Maximum initial access duration for the two roles in this synthetic policy.
cases.insert_text: This unrelated paragraph is deliberately inserted between the caption and the table. It must not be mistaken for part of the table.
cases.purpose: Probe whether table captions remain explicitly associated with tables after intervening prose is inserted.
